**3B.7 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

Overall: **mixed to negative**. The government did put forward some concrete protection measures for migrants, indigenous/Afromexican communities, and women/girls, but independent 2024 evidence still shows persistent violence, weak protection, and recurrent abuse affecting journalists, migrants, indigenous people, and other vulnerable groups.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Anuncia DIF Nacional acciones de protección a niñez migrante | Sistema Nacional DIF | 2024-06-17 | https://www.gob.mx/difnacional/articulos/anuncia-dif-nacional-acciones-de-proteccion-a-ninez-migrante | DIF said it had 88 active centers for migrant children and was expanding capacity and services for accompanied and unaccompanied minors. This is direct protection for a highly vulnerable group. | 3B.7 |
| Positive | Iniciativa de Reforma Constitucional sobre Derechos de los Pueblos Indígenas y Afromexicano | INPI | 2024-02-05 | https://www.gob.mx/inpi/documentos/iniciativa-de-reforma-constitucional-sobre-derechos-de-los-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicano-357107 | The executive-backed reform aimed to recognize indigenous and Afromexican peoples as subjects of public rights with legal personality and patrimony. This is a meaningful rights-protection move for minority groups. | 3B.7 |
| Positive | Gobierno de México instala Mecanismo para la Implementación y Protección de los Derechos de los Pueblos Indígenas | SEGOB / INPI | 2024-12-11 | https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/gobierno-de-mexico-instala-mecanismo-para-la-implementacion-y-proteccion-de-los-derechos-de-los-pueblos-indigenas-385941?idiom=fr | The government installed a formal mechanism to coordinate implementation and protection of indigenous rights across the federal administration. That is direct institutional protection for a vulnerable group. | 3B.7, 3B.4 |
| Positive | Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC | SSPC | 2024-08-06 | https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc | SSPC reported a reinforced anti-violence strategy for women and girls, including outreach, training, and a claimed reduction in feminicide versus 2018. This is the strongest official positive claim for women’s protection. | 3B.7 |
| Positive | Mexican government offers public apology to families of missing girls and women and femicide victims in Ciudad Juarez | SRE | 2024-03-06 | https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexican-government-offers-public-apology-to-families-of-missing-girls-and-women-and-femicide-victims-in-ciudad-juarez?idiom=en | The Mexican state formally acknowledged responsibility and apologized to families in the Ciudad Juárez case. That is a limited but real accountability/protection signal for women and girls. | 3B.7, 2B.9, 3B.4 |
| Positive, limited | Biden and AMLO agreed to coordinate immediate measures to reduce irregular border crossings while protecting human rights | Reuters | 2024-04-30 | https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/ | Mexico and the U.S. agreed to migration controls while explicitly pairing them with human-rights protection. This is narrow but real evidence of a vulnerable-group issue handled without blanket punitive framing. | 3B.7, 2B.1, 2B.7 |
| Negative | Mexico: Killings of journalists under state protection show urgent need to strengthen federal mechanism | Amnesty International / CPJ | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/mexico-killings-journalists-strengthen-federal-mechanism/ | Journalists under the federal protection mechanism were still being killed, showing that state protection for a vulnerable group was failing in practice. | 3B.7, 3B.4, 3B.2 |
| Negative | Mexico | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico | HRW says migrants in Mexico are regularly preyed upon, checkpoints disproportionately affect Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is broad negative evidence on protecting vulnerable groups. | 3B.7, 3B.1, 3B.2, 3B.4 |
| Negative | Mexico’s military’s role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/ | Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants and the military’s account was disputed by local residents. This is direct evidence of lethal harm to a vulnerable group rather than protection. | 3B.7, 3B.1, 2B.9, 3B.2 |

**Assessment**

- Best positive evidence is concentrated in **official protection measures** for migrant children, indigenous/Afromexican rights, and women/girls.
- Best negative evidence is stronger: **journalist protection failures, migrant abuse, and HRW’s broad finding that vulnerable groups remained exposed to predation and violence**.
- Net: **mixed, leaning negative**. The government had protection instruments, but the 2024 record does not show that they were sufficient or consistently effective.

**Search gap**

- I found **limited direct 2024 evidence on religious, sectarian, or caste-specific violence** in Mexico; the evidence is mostly about **women, children, migrants, indigenous/Afromexican communities, and journalists**.
- The positive side is also partly **official/self-reported**, so it should be weighted more lightly than the independent negative reporting.
